_comment: Only two channels are supported: 'preview' (ROCm 7.2.1 from AMD apt) and 'stable' (ROCm 7.2.2 SDK bundle from lemonade-sdk/rocm-stable GitHub release). Any other version or source must be rejected by the install step.
